## Profile

I am a **Certified CompTIA CySA+** professional based in **Fairfield, OH**, with a Bachelor's and Master's degree in Information Technology. My work sits at the intersection of **Cybersecurity**, **AI Engineering**, and **Data Analytics**—from building machine-learning intrusion detection systems to deploying real-time geospatial anomaly dashboards for fraud and internal threat visibility.

I bring hands-on experience across security operations, data interpretation, and full-stack analytics tooling. Whether lecturing on AI engineering, consulting on IT and cybersecurity for financial institutions, or hardening systems against emerging threats, I focus on measurable outcomes: faster detection, clearer visibility, and defensible security posture.

Alongside my IT and security work, I bring practical **manufacturing production** experience on the shop floor—programming and operating **CNC** machines, running **3D printing** workflows for prototypes and tooling, building and validating **3D models** from engineering drawings, and supporting **PLC**-driven automation for repeatable, spec-compliant output. That blend of digital systems and hands-on fabrication helps me connect software, hardware, and production quality in one workflow.

**Contact:** [sophalcamchan38@gmail.com](mailto:sophalcamchan38@gmail.com)

## Research & Academic

My published research includes **four peer-reviewed outputs** on **machine learning and medical image mining for knee osteoarthritis** detection and staging (Prince of Songkla University), with first-author journal articles in *IJASEIT* (2020, **AUC 0.912**) and *International Journal of Computers and Applications* (2020, **AUC 0.917**), plus a Springer conference paper (2019) and M.S. thesis. I now extend that analytical foundation into **cybersecurity** and **data science education** at ITC and beyond.

**Selected publications:** Chan, Dittakan & Garcia-Constantino (2020); Chan, Dittakan & El Salhi (2020); Chan & Dittakan (2019, Springer).

**Full list, citations, and academic timeline:** [Research & Academic →](research.qmd)
